messages:
oliver: Quick report from the workshop today  the new Next + LangChain sample kit confuses folks around auth and SDK parity. Long streams in the interactive demo either fail silently or loop retries.
sana: can you give the minimal repro?
oliver: clone samplekit, follow README to create demo token (ephemeral), run `npm run dev` then open /notebooks/interactive.ipynb and run the 'summarize large doc' cell. After ~75s it shows a socket close and then retries repeatedly.
jules: which SDK version in the kit?
oliver: package pins show redwood-js 0.7.8 and the python notebook uses redwood-py 0.8.1 via binder.
sana: this smells like the 401-during-stream parity gap. JS got a change to abort retries on 401 for SSE; python still retries, causing backoff storms and 429s.
jules: short-term fix suggestion: update README to recommend longer-lived dev tokens for local interactive runs, and add a TTL preflight check in the notebook that warns if token <= 120s. Also add a clear UI cell to surface "Auth expired during stream" instead of the notebook hanging.
oliver: I can open a PR to adjust the docs and notebook. Would also like to bump the pinned python sdk to 0.8.2-rc which includes the midstream-401 guard.
sdk-team-bot: ISSUE-502 created to track Python SDK parity for midstream 401 handling. Assigned to @jules.
jules: I'll implement an SDK change: when streaming, treat 401 as terminal and surface AuthenticationError instead of retrying; expose an opt-in flag `allow_stream_401_retry` default false for server-side legacy behavior. Will add telemetry counter `stream_auth_abort`.
ci: preview deploy link: https://preview.redwood.dev/devex/samplekit/pr-502
oliver: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/502 includes README note, a preflight TTL cell, and a notebook UX improvement that catches StreamClosed and prints auth guidance. Verified the notebook now fails-fast with a clear message.
sana: can we also add an eval in eng-ml nightly that simulates a token expiry mid-stream to ensure this doesn't regress?
jules: yes adding an eval harness test under eng-ml/evals/stream_auth_expiry that spins a fake SSE server and forces a 401 at t=60s. CI will assert we return AuthenticationError and do not enter retry loops.
oliver: excellent, this should drastically reduce confusion in workshops. thanks all for the quick turnaround. :)
